newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq investigates killing of Jordan embassy driver.
newsitem.headline: Iraq investigates killing of Jordan embassy driver.

text.p: Iraqi authorities are investigating the killing of a Jordanian embassy driver who was shot while driving a diplomatic car on the desert highway between Baghdad and Amman, Jordan's ambassador said on Tuesday.
"Iraqi authorities are carrying on investigations to find the criminals who killed Omar Ahmed Ali, our driver and they will inform us of the results," Jordanian envoy Bassam Qaqish told Reuters.
He said the killers took the embassy's diplomatic bag which contained 250 Jordanian passports and other documents.
"I do not know if there was money in the bag or not, I have to find out," he said.
Qaqish said the incident took place on Monday afternoon near a desert village half way along the 500 km (310 mile) highway between Baghdad and Traibel, the Iraqi checkpoint at the Jordanian border.
Jordan's Ad-Dustour newspaper, quoting travellers returning from Iraq, said the gunmen fired a hail of bullets at the car.
There has been no comment from the Iraqi goverment on the incident so far.
